title: Concept: MD5 selected by name (csharp) — review required
description: In csharp, naming MD5 (MD5.Creates*(s*)) requests a broken digest. Name-selected digests hide inside factory calls, so reviewers must check the string, not just the call. The csharp-specific remedy is selecting SHA256.Create().
applicability: csharp codebases selecting digests by name; single-line lexical scope.
risk: Same as any MD5 use: forged digests where security is assumed; LOW default severity, raised when the digest guards trust.
